scope: Independent stdlib-only review using ONLY actual completed conditional-primitives-v1 raw rank JSON, not the new analysis parser or its output. No remote/model/GPU/test/production changes.

definitions.six_terms: Recomputed from raw saved original-owner scalar effects; their sum is Cin-Cout.
definitions.unique_statistics: For each UID/source-step/source-position/token-ID identity, average repeated signed transport scalars first, then compute statistics over42 identities per layer. All52 statistics and raw slots are also retained.
definitions.norm_joint_conditional_minus_single_pair: Original full-span joint coefficient contraction minus original single-pair FP64 continuous RMS finite projection. Includes arithmetic in saved joint coefficients; not a pure isolated joint-method error.
definitions.norm_storage: Original HF continuous FP32 projection minus the same HF CPU native BF16 output projection. GPU/CPU native discrepancy remains a separate term.
definitions.addition_storage: FP32 CPU branch sum minus the same dtype CPU BF16 branch sum; actual GPU-vs-CPU stored sum independently checked.
definitions.numerical_scope: Descriptive projections; no new acceptance thresholds, corrections, causal fractions or kernel-defect claims.

limitations: Only42 fixed probes/21 successful first responses of checkpoint25; no conclusion about all responses or the whole training degradation.
Signed subblock terms can cancel; their mean absolute sizes are not causal percentages.
MLP and mixer components remain unresolved conditional/numerical residuals; native FP16 FLA context is preserved but its storage effects are not separately isolated here.
Native singleEOS effects are current Qwen readout model effects, not newly verified world interventions.
Old selected v6 scalar results are not merged into these current42 statistics.
